_source: data/association/*.json (PR 1; each root's top 25 partners by LLR, itself derived from Leeds Quranic Arabic Corpus v0.4 via scripts/compute-association-stats.mjs) and data/roots-summary.json (raw frequency).

_graph.note: Edges are the union of every (root, partner) pair recorded in any root's data/association/ top-25-by-LLR partner list, not the full set of all pairs meeting the 5-shared-verse threshold corpus-wide (PR 1 reports 8,556 such pairs before the top-25-per-root cut). This graph is a subset by construction, since data/association/ was never designed to expose the full pair set and this script does not modify or extend it.

_algorithms.degree: Count of distinct neighbors (raw); normalized = raw / (N-1).
_algorithms.weightedDegree: Sum of incident edge weights (LLR); also called strength.
_algorithms.betweenness: Brandes' algorithm (2001), O(V*E), on the unweighted graph (every edge length 1; edge weight ignored for shortest-path computation).
_algorithms.eigenvector: Power iteration on the weighted adjacency matrix (edge weight = LLR): x_0 = uniform (every node = 1); x_{k+1} = A * x_k, L2-normalized; tolerance 1e-9, max 1000 iterations.
_algorithms.spearmanCorrelation: Tie-corrected: Pearson correlation of average ranks (standard Spearman's rho with ties).
